## Appearance

Harcourt is a red-haired educator with a small pointed chin. She has sweet lips, large and magnificent eyes, and wears her reddish hair in sleek waves or in a lengthy crimson plait.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Ann Harcourt possesses an extremely poor temper. Because of this, she is required to learn how to control her temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046)_

## Quotes

> "I could assist you so greatly at present and save you effort in numerous manners. For that single reason, I could truly desire to have been one."
>
> — Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "If I were traveling by car, I would bring you. However, I plan to go on foot, a distance too great for legs belonging to an eight-year-old. Furthermore, Cedric will accompany me, and I suspect his presence does not bring you pleasure."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004)

> "Upon seeing him on the playground, he was so soaked that I dispatched him straight home to get dressed before I could learn the reason."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P6](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0006)

> "Emptiness is the absolute worst thing . . . and my departure from your existence is not happening. Letters and vacations do exist, after all. My dear, you appear somewhat pale and exhausted, I fear."
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0033)

> "Belinda, it seems to me that Miss Rosalind requires a change of scenery. Her time spent here in solitude is far too great. Is there no way we can persuade her to take a short journey?"
>
> — Harcourt — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P46](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0046)

## Relationships

### [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harcourt--miss-pembroke.md)

[Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) is a friend of Harcourt, serving as a frequent visitor and favorite companion at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) since the first volume. Despite this connection, she does not appear directly in Harcourt's local family gatherings, such as when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) after winning her scholarship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), +2 more_

- Friend of — frequent visitor and favorite companion at Beechwood  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)</sub>

### [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/belinda--harcourt.md)

[Belinda](../character/belinda.md) and Harcourt are close friends who reside in the same household at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) in Volume 2. They spend their time together picking strawberries for tea, discussing Miss Rosalind's poor health and melancholic mood, and delighting in the romantic reunion and subsequent wedding of [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +14 more_

- Friend of — close friends residing in the same household (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>
